cohort: 370 pregnant women (185 cases with non-severe PPH and 185 controls without PPH) matched for age, body mass index, term, and mode of delivery.
finding: Predelivery platelet count was independently associated with non-severe PPH.
mod_finding: In a subset analysis of vaginal deliveries, median predelivery TGA thrombin peak was lower and median predelivery PGA lag phase was longer in non-severe PPH cases compared to controls.
